a.title: A shift of 1e-12 of a whole board moves routes on each router, also on `corners`, which has no rooms. So a route depends on input bits that carry no meaning. The measure is the routes moved over 1e-6 for each router, under a stated shift, with at least 5 distinct shifts from named seeds. The target is 0, or a stated limit when 0 costs too much. Due 11-14. A route also depends on the estimate of the search: with no key, `shared` is `corners` with other tie breaks. So a test holds the same bytes at `floor` 1, 0.5 and 0.25. This is an item of stability and not of length: the best route among the ties gains 0.014 % of the length over the 15 families of `screen-v3`, and 0.086 % on `many-groups`, the largest of the families. This item also gives the floor of each route measure, and it is due 2026-11-14.
